vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: compound-eng-file-todos
Version: 2.56.0

The skill bundle implements a structured, file-based todo tracking system using Markdown files within a dedicated `todos/` directory. It provides templates, workflows, and standard bash commands (e.g., `grep`, `ls`, `mv`) for managing task lifecycles. The logic is entirely consistent with its stated purpose, and there are no indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection attacks across the documentation or scripts.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only, file-based todo management guide for a todos/ directory; its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose and it does not request credentials or install code.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and included files (template, workflows, quick-reference) all align with managing markdown todo files in a todos/ directory. There are no unrelated required env vars, binaries, or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and supporting docs contain explicit file naming conventions, frontmatter, templates, and example shell commands (ls, grep, mv, cp). That scope is appropriate for a filesystem-based todo system. Minor note: workflows mention integrations (gh CLI, slash commands, Review agent) but the skill does not declare required binaries or credentials for those integrations — they are described as optional integrations rather than required actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files. Nothing will be written to disk or downloaded by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The instructions do reference repository files (src/...) and external links as examples, which is reasonable for a task-tracking template.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is true (the skill will not be autonomously invoked). The skill does not request system-level persistence or modify other skills/configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This is an instruction-only todo/template system and appears coherent. Before installing or using it: (1) verify you want plaintext markdown todo files in a todos/ directory and are comfortable editing them; (2) be aware the docs include shell commands (grep, ls, mv, cp) — run those only in the intended repository and avoid elevated privileges; (3) if you plan to enable integrations mentioned (gh CLI, slash commands, review agents), understand those require additional tools and credentials which this skill does not request; (4) because the skill has no code or installs, there is no hidden network behavior in the package itself, but always review any external scripts or automation you run that act on these files.
